{{Top|leg}}
A '''scrapeater''' was a [[Crab/Legends|crab-like]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that was found on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]]. The creatures each had a spiny back and multiple [[Limb/Legends|legs]] and had a [[Diet/Legends|diet]] of trash.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|131|scrapeater}}</ref>
